annotations.text:
Design system

Paper #fbfaf7, ink #241e1a. All seven accents are oklch(0.55 0.13 h), one hue each:
01 P vs NP 265
02 Riemann 25
03 Navier-Stokes 235
04 Poincare 195
05 Yang-Mills 145
06 BSD 65
07 Hodge 320

The page itself is black on paper. Color belongs to the problem, not the chrome.

Type: Newsreader display, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono labels and readouts.

The four figures on the Riemann page are computed, not drawn: primes by sieve, Li(x) by numeric integration, the first 25 zeta zeros at their published values, and the explicit formula for the psi staircase. The slider under figure 04 works.
